findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Dangerous use of pickle and yaml
 * @description Detects use of unsafe deserialization APIs that could be exposed to untrusted data by library users.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/pydantic/unsafe-deserialization-surfaces
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-502
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("pickle").getMember(["load", "loads", "Unpickler"]).getACall()
  or
  call = API::moduleImport("yaml").getMember(["load", "unsafe_load"]).getACall()
select call, "Use of potentially unsafe deserialization API; ensure untrusted data never reaches this call."
findings.hypothesis: Pydantic may use pickle or yaml.load internally in ways that could deserialize untrusted data.

message.text: Use of potentially unsafe deserialization API; ensure untrusted data never reaches this call.
Use of potentially unsafe deserialization API; ensure untrusted data never reaches this call.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Exec/eval or dynamic import usage
 * @description Flags use of eval, exec, or __import__ which can be dangerous if exposed to untrusted input.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/pydantic/dynamic-execution-surfaces
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-094
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::builtin("eval").getACall() or
  call = API::builtin("exec").getACall() or
  call = API::builtin("__import__").getACall()
select call, "Use of dynamic code execution; ensure no untrusted input can reach this call."
findings.hypothesis: Pydantic might use eval/exec or dynamic imports for model construction or schema handling, which could be risky if misused by consumers.

message.text: Use of dynamic code execution; ensure no untrusted input can reach this call.
